title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Member Refrigerant Allowance Line
content:
On Repair and Emergency Service Calls, a Comfort Club member whose agreement is active has a refrigerant allowance on each completed call. The refrigerant billed on the call's refrigerant line is relieved by one member refrigerant allowance line. That line names the refrigerant line and the member's agreement, records the pounds covered, and lowers the balance owing on the call by the value of those pounds. The allowance is owed on the call once the call is completed and carries a refrigerant line, for a member whose agreement is active.

## Posting tool: `post_refrigerant_allowance_39aa6c52`

**What it does.** The tool posts a Comfort Club refrigerant allowance against the refrigerant line of one service call's invoice, covering pounds of refrigerant free of charge. Each call of the tool adds one `member_refrigerant_allowance` line to the call's invoice, dated today. The line names the refrigerant line it reduces and the Comfort Club agreement whose benefit applies, and records the pounds covered. The call's invoice balance is lowered by exactly the amount given. The tool does not check eligibility or amounts; it books what it is given.

**How it is invoked.** This is a hidden agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it by the name `post_refrigerant_allowance_39aa6c52`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ticket_id` | Reference number of the service call | Id, read from the service call lookup |
| `source_line_id` | Reference number of the refrigerant line the allowance reduces | Id, read from the call's invoice lines |
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the account holder | Id, read from the customer profile lookup |
| `agreement_id` | Reference number of the customer's Comfort Club agreement | Id, read from the agreement lookup |
| `recall_of_ticket_id` | Reference number of the earlier call this visit returns to under the repair guarantee, copied from the call record | Id; an empty string when the call record shows no earlier call |
| `quantity` | Pounds of refrigerant the allowance covers | Number, up to 1 decimal place, in pounds |
| `amount` | Value of the pounds covered | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; a value with more decimals is rounded to the cent half up when booked |

**Return.** The tool returns a receipt with `line_id` (reference number of the new allowance line), `ticket_id`, `line_type` (always `member_refrigerant_allowance`), `source_line_id`, `agreement_id`, `recall_of_ticket_id` (as passed), `quantity` (pounds covered), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `ticket_balance` (the call's invoice balance in USD after the allowance). A receipt carrying a `line_id` means the allowance is on the invoice. The new line is visible at once among the call's invoice lines and in the call's new balance.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with reference T-1001 whose refrigerant line is L-7, for agreement A-55, posted with `quantity` 1.0 and `amount` 89.00, returns a receipt showing the new allowance line, `quantity` 1.0, `amount` 89.00 and a `ticket_balance` $89.00 lower than before.
